Out of scope: the replacement CRDs' own feature specs, the auto-generated experimental CRDs, other IaC tools, and the parent domain.

Kubernetes' API policy (Rule #1) says API elements may only be removed by incrementing the version of the API group. Kubernetes CRDs support deprecating a whole version (`deprecated`, `deprecationWarning`). AKO has removed fields within `atlas.mongodb.com/v1` before: v2.0.1 removed `spec.advancedDeploymentSpec` without bumping the CRD version, and a user complained in issue #1330 that this overwrote the existing CRD in a breaking way for existing clusters on operator upgrade (the issue was closed as not planned). Sources: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/using-api/deprecation-policy/

It covers which fields were deprecated, in which release, what replaced them, the migration procedure, the controller behaviour, and the current removal status.

The documented order has five steps: (1) annotate the parent resource with `mongodb.com/atlas-reconciliation-policy: "skip"`; (2) delete the parameters; (3) create the new CRD; (4) wait for its status to sync; (5) remove the skip annotation.
